description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Notify to convene the meeting for the election of Vice Chairman of Delft Pradeshiya Sabha (N.P.)
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the reconvening of a meeting for the election of a Vice Chairman for a local authority (Delft Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. This content specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters including election meetings and procedures.
